notes.title: Discord server LIVE + First playtests 🕹️
notes.content: [p]Hi all! This is the first announcement. How exciting![/p][p][/p][h1]Discord Server LIVE 📢[/h1][p]The Discord server is now live 🥳[/p][p]Get involved early and help shape the game![/p][p]If you're a fan of the adventure game genre, I'm very eager to hear from you 😊[/p][p]You can leave your suggestions and ideas, talk about your expectations from the game or just hangout in #off-topic 😄[/p][p]Join here: [url="https://discord.gg/MpEf4gaajF"]https://discord.gg/MpEf4gaajF[/url]. Feel free to share the link with your friends.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106861/c72d2bc5367d48dc8b7f130dcc8cfea595519f7b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Looking for playtesters 👀[/h1][p]If you're interested in becoming a playtester for Leveleers, sign up [url="https://www.catonkeyboardgames.com/playtest"]here[/url].[/p][p]You'll get some rewards if you take part in a playtesting session:[/p][list][*][p]Your name in the credits[/p][/*][*][p]A copy of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Playtester role on Discord and access to private playtesting channels[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106861/1c6226aa5f35d1d3f617023a25ac7d64ff43c7e6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Stijn from Cat on Keyboard Games.[/p]
